### Regarding Deferred-Fee and Pay-At-The-End Options

True "deferred-fee" arrangements (where legal fees for family law property settlements are delayed until the final property settlement disbursement) are generally evaluated on a case-by-case basis rather than advertised as a blanket policy, as they depend on the existence of liquid assets or real estate in the pool. Some regional boutique firms also coordinate with third-party specialist legal disbursement funders (such as JustFund) if litigation or heavy settlement work is required.[[1]](https://bartonfamilylaw.com.au/fixed-fees/)
